description:
Enable the live chat subsystem and configure a specific chat group for Tech Support.

1. Enable System-wide Chat:
   - Navigate to Admin -> System Settings.
   - Find 'Allow Chats' and set it to '1' (Enabled).
   - Save changes.

2. Create a Tech Support Chat Group:
   - Navigate to Admin -> Chat Groups (this menu option appears after enabling chats).
   - Add a New Chat Group with the following details:
     * Chat Group ID: TECHSUP
     * Chat Group Name: Tech Support Chat
     * Active: Y
     * Group Color: CCCCFF
     * Welcome Message: Welcome to Tech Support. Please describe your issue.
     * Admin User Group: ADMIN (or default)
   - Submit/Save the new group.

metadata.expected_welcome_message: Welcome to Tech Support. Please describe your issue.
